newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock fund flows slide - survey.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock fund flows slide - survey.

text.p: Cash flows into U.S. equity funds slid to $4 million for the three-day period ended February 6 compared to $1.19 billion for the two-day period, ended February 3, according to Mutual Fund Trim Tabs.
Growth funds posted inflows of $110 million versus $351 million, and small cap funds had outflows of $15 million, according to the fund tracking firm.
International funds outflows of $89 million compared to inflows of $164 million.

Bond funds inflows dropped to $336 million versus $983 million. Muni funds recorded inflows of $16 million versus $618 million, and corporate/income/global funds posted inflows of $84 million versus $114 million. High yield funds had inflows of $56 million versus $99 million.
